name: fairclinic-review-replies
description: Fairclinic Review Replies: online reviews that need a reply (low ratings first, and those that mention health or care details), reply drafts that thank or invite a call and never confirm the reviewer is a patient or client, and a check of any proposed reply for wording that would disclose a visit, care, records, a date or a name. One named person posts; the agent never does. Reviewer names are masked before results reach the model.
